limitations: Repository-only. Auto-merge OFF; NOT merged and NOT deployed without a separate explicit Sponsor merge/deploy GO. No production/DB mutation, no financial action, no OAuth/credential action, no mailbox change.

This PR ENABLES CAPTURE of an authenticated Pepperstone withdrawal email; it does not by itself make the genuine 2026-11-05 email appear. Appearance additionally requires: (a) the mailbox OAuth re-consent the Sponsor performed on 2026-11-08 (done); (b) this PR merged + deployed; (c) the paused ingestion timer (guvfx-broker-ingest.timer, stopped to protect the uncrossed cursor at ~2026-10-31) resumed, so forward catch-up retains the now-allowlisted Pepperstone message; (d) the withdrawal-correlation pass. Until (b)-(d), the genuine email stays protected but uncaptured.

Three EXISTING tests changed (directly related, called out): tests_capability_guard (test renamed to assert only Pepperstone declares EXTERNAL_WITHDRAWAL + module docstring), tests_broker_profile_catalogue (same), tests_stream_b_review_regressions (the untouched-seed reverse test restores Pepperstone to pristine seed before exercising 0026's reverse, which 0027's activation otherwise and correctly blocks).

The genuine Pepperstone message is a 'request/confirmation-required' email; the surfaced lifecycle state will be CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED (or REQUESTED), never COMPLETED. No completion/timing is fabricated. If Pepperstone later sends processing/completion emails, the existing parser + correlation advance the single record truthfully.
The unrelated pre-existing 'strategies' index-rename drift reported by an all-apps makemigrations --check is present on canonical main e12a20c9 and is NOT introduced by this PR.
